Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Deal

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Deal
public class Deal extends Object
An accepted DealRequest and its own lifecycle (SRS class diagram, 0..1 per request).

The buyer, seller, listing and deal type are derived through the request, so they are never stored twice. Deals are created and moved between states only by DealLifecycle.
